jobs.description:
JCPenney is seeking a Supply Chain Security Officer to help keep facilities safe and profitable by executing security programs and investigating suspicious activities. The role includes surveillance, incident reporting, and ensuring compliance across all access points.

You will operate CCTV systems, support shrinkage prevention, and respond to emergencies as needed, including entry control and post patrol duties across the facility.
